name: call_object_function
purpose: Invoke a named UFUNCTION on any objectPath via reflection — the only lane that executes cooked-BP bytecode (e.g. 'Editor Apply Spline').
engineApi: FindFunction (Object.h:1197); ProcessEvent (Object.h:1391); CallFunctionByNameWithArguments (Object.h:1419); ImportText_Direct (UnrealType.h:493-499); ExportText_Direct (UnrealType.h:599); FUNC_Native/FUNC_BlueprintCallable/FUNC_NetFuncFlags (Script.h:141,157,178); ParmsSize (Class.h:1795)
cooked: WORKS — exists because cooked BP bytecode executes; native stubs of reconstructed plugins succeed but do nothing (isNative echo flags this)
prevents: run_console 'ke ...' cannot address a single actor instance by path nor tokenise BP function names with spaces; add_function_call is graph-authoring only, no runtime invoke
hazards: STUB-NATIVE caveat: calling a native function of a reconstructed plugin executes the empty stub — succeeds, does nothing; response echoes isNative
Refuse net functions (FUNC_NetFuncFlags) and latent functions (meta=Latent) — cannot run inside a single bridge frame
Missing required args are zero-filled — response echoes argsDefaulted to expose silent zeros
Callees that compile Blueprints or tear down worlds are out of contract
